newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Samanda to buy 11 timber-based firms.
newsitem.headline: Samanda to buy 11 timber-based firms.

text.p: Malaysian label and adhesive-tape maker Samanda Holdings Bhd said it was seeking to acquire 11 timber-based companies from logging conglomerate WTK Group for 837.5 million ringgit.

In a statement issued by its merchant bankers on Tuesday, Samanda said the companies it intended to buy were Cairfield Sdn Bhd, Gopoint Sdn Bhd, Sarawak Moulding Industries Bhd, Woodbanks Industries (M) Sdn Bhd, Kuching Plywood Bhd, Sanitama Sdn Bhd, Limpah Mewah Sdn Bhd, First Count Sdn Bhd, Song Loggin Company Sdn Bhd, Ninjas Development Sdn Bhd and Sut Sawmill Sdn Bhd.

The acquisitions would be paid for with 83.6 million ringgit in cash and 57.33 million new shares in Samanda at 13.15 ringgit per share, the statement said. The deal is conditional upon the approval of regulatory authorities.
The new share issues will make WTK Group the largest shareholder in Samanda with a 28.59 percent stake, overtaking Kosa Bahagia Sdn Bhd whose 32.11 percent stake will be reduced to 16.43 percent.

Samanda's statement also said WTK Group will sign a profit guarantee agreement that ensures Samanda of not less than 126 million ringgit in pretax profit annually from the 11 companies in the three financial years to 1999.
